investigation_notes.Recent Events Summary: Multiple prior queries from the same source IP to similarly structured, randomly named .biz domains (two NXDOMAINs followed by a NOERROR for x1j2k3-v9.biz within the same 5-minute window). No recent similar alerts found in the alert history.
investigation_notes.Description: A high-entropy DNS TXT stream from srv-sql-core-01 to x1j2k3-v9.biz carried Base64-like subdomain labels that decode to SQL queries, credential-like strings, an admin email, and an SSL key identifier. The root domain was registered 1 day ago and the host showed rapid queries to similarly named domains immediately prior to this event, which together strongly suggest active data exfiltration rather than benign diagnostics. Given the presence of decoded sensitive host/credential artifacts and the domain's newness, this alert is prioritized as High Priority.
